description: This is a test class for the CountryService in the OrangeHRM Admin Service module. It contains unit tests for various methods of the CountryService class, such as retrieving country and province lists, getting countries by name or code, and verifying the functioning of setters and getters.

classes.name: CountryServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the CountryService, testing its methods for correctness and integration with DAO and entity objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a new instance of CountryService.

methods.name: testGetCountryDao
methods.description: Verifies that getCountryDao returns a CountryDao instance and that setCountryDao correctly sets it.

methods.name: testSetCountryDao
methods.description: Checks that setting a new CountryDao instance updates the service accordingly.

methods.name: testGetCountryList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of countries from the DAO.

methods.name: testGetProvinceList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of provinces from the DAO.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Tests fetching a country object by its name, including non-existing entries.

methods.name: testGetCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Tests fetching a country object by its code, including non-existing entries.

methods.name: testGetProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Tests fetching a province object by its code, including non-existing entries.

methods.name: testGetCountryArray
methods.description: Tests the conversion of country list entities into a normalized array suitable for UI/use, involving NormalizerService.
